_comment: Food/water consumption consequences config (issue #134 consequences). ConsequencesSystem autoload reads this to drive dehydration, starvation, stamina, and emergency rationing. All tunables live here so designers can balance without touching code. Rates are per-second; stamina is 0–100. Thresholds are resource counts below which the named effect activates. Emergency rationing multiplier scales consumption_manager rates when the ship is critically low on both food and water.
